# Cheat Sheets {#sec-cheat-sheets}

Every chapter ends with a cheat sheet: the chapter's commands or
decisions in one table, each paired with the check that confirms
it worked. This appendix is an index to those tables, not a copy of
them. The tables stay in their chapters, next to the prose that
explains when each command is the wrong one, and a cheat sheet read
without that prose is how a confident mistake begins.

@tbl-cheat-sheet-index lists the chapters in reading order, grouped
by part, with a cross-reference to each chapter's table. In the
HTML edition each reference is a link; in print, it gives the table
number, which begins with the chapter number or appendix letter.

The cheat sheets are most useful in the second quarter and after
the course, when the question is no longer how a tool works but
which command, and which check, you used the last time. A reader
looking for a term rather than a command should use the glossary
(@sec-glossary) instead.
